title: 第59章 李青山归来
content_zh:
第59章 李青山归来-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

“好嘞！”

李青书连忙将炮仗接过去点燃，丢在路旁，火星顺着引线迅速燃烧了上去，十几枚炮仗在夏日传出响亮的爆炸声，老李家脸上纷纷洋溢出一抹笑意。

李老屯今天精神百倍。

站在村头的最前面，昂首挺胸，就像是一名刚刚打过胜仗的将军一般。

直到石溪村二十多口子走到村口。

“那个，三奎啊，你儿子呢？”

“在哪个担架上呢？”

李大奎上前一步，望着站在李财身后的李三奎问道。

“我儿子在担架上干什么？”李三奎微微一怔，脸上闪过一抹懵逼之色道。

老李家在干什么？

不是闹翻了吗？

怎么自己回来，还放鞭炮呢？

哦，肯定是看自己家儿子打了这么多野物，想要将关系缓和了，然后问自家要肉？

不可能！

我李三奎怎么可能再往火坑里面跳？

“有事情跟我说，我儿子没空！”李三奎不等到李大奎说话，便抢先道。

“哈哈，老三，你得节哀！”

“还有啊，你们老两口现在也是无依无靠的绝户了，但是没关系，你这不是还有侄子吗？”

“抽个时间，把你们家那套宅子，过户给青书！”

“没问题吧？”

李大奎畅快大笑道。

吃绝户的感觉，真是好啊！

李三奎以及身后随着一起上山帮忙的汉子们，全都一脸懵逼，诧异的望着李大奎。

不是，这家伙疯了？

“绝户？”

“过户给李青书？”

“李大奎，谁给你的胆子？”

“这么嚣张？你爹李老屯知道吗？”

就在这时。

李青山突然挤开人群走了出来，顺便将手中装着香獐子的背篓递给了大壮，眉宇之间流露出一抹阴沉的戾气，李大奎感觉自己被一只雄虎盯着，浑身忍不住微微一颤，面色瞬间煞白。

李……李青山？

这二流子不是死了吗？

怎么回事？

“啊？”

村头石溪村的村民，全都一脸懵逼，齐刷刷将脑袋凑了过来，望着活生生站在面前的李青山，眼神中满是惊悚与骇然。

不是，什么情况？

这怎么还活着？

"Okay!"

Li Qingshu quickly took the firecrackers, lit them, and threw them by the roadside. The sparks quickly burned along the fuses. More than a dozen firecrackers made loud explosions in the summer, and a smile spread across the faces of the old Li family.

Li Laotun is full of energy today.

Standing at the front of the village, head held high, like a general who had just won a battle.

Until more than 20 people from Shixi Village walked to the entrance of the village.

"Well, Sankui, where is your son?"

"Which stretcher is it on?"

Li Dakui took a step forward and asked Li Sankui, who was standing behind Li Cai.

"What is my son doing on the stretcher?" Li Sankui was slightly startled, and a look of confusion flashed across his face.

What are Lao Li's doing?

Didn't they have a falling out?

Why did you set off firecrackers when you came back by yourself?

Oh, he must have seen his son kill so many wild animals and wanted to ease the relationship, so he asked for meat?

impossible!

How could I, Li Sankui, jump into the fire pit again?

"If you have something to tell me, my son is not free!" Li Sankui said before Li Dakui could speak.

"Haha, third child, you have to express your condolences!"

"Also, you two are now helpless and homeless, but it doesn't matter. Don't you still have a nephew?"

"Take some time to transfer the ownership of your house to Qingshu!"

"Is it okay?"

Li Dakui laughed heartily.

It feels so good to eat like crazy!

Li Sankui and the men who followed him up the mountain to help all looked confused and looked at Li Dakui in surprise.

No, is this guy crazy?

"Exhausted?"

"Transfer ownership to Li Qingshu?"

"Li Dakui, who gave you the courage?"

"So arrogant? Does your father, Li Laotun, know?"

Just then.

Li Qingshan suddenly squeezed through the crowd and walked out, handing the basket with fragrant deer seeds to Da Zhuang. There was a gloomy anger between his eyebrows. Li Dakui felt that he was being stared at by a male tiger. He couldn't help but tremble slightly, and his face turned pale instantly.

Li...Li Qingshan?

Isn’t this second-rate guy dead?

What's going on?

"Huh?"

The villagers in Shixi Village at the head of the village were all confused. They all turned their heads over and looked at Li Qingshan standing in front of them, their eyes full of horror and horror.

No, what happened?

How is this still alive?
